summary_en: Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 to conduct MBO tender offer at ¥2,250/share. Minimum 6,707,800 shares to be acquired (66.62% post-acquisition ownership). Offer period 4 August – 15 September 2026 (30 business days). Target: complete delisting via acquisition of all outstanding shares. Board unanimously recommends participation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation to Accept Tender Offer
translation_en_brief: Japan Property Management Center Co., Ltd. (ticker 3276, TSE Prime) announced on 3 August 2026 that its board has approved and recommended to shareholders a management buyout tender offer. Two newly-formed acquisition vehicles—Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 (both established 13 July 2026, owned respectively by Helsinki1 and Helsinki2)—will launch a public cash tender offer for all outstanding ordinary shares at ¥2,250 per share, with a minimum acquisition target of 6,707,800 shares (representing 66.62% post-acquisition ownership after consolidation). The offer period runs from 4 August to 15 September 2026 (30 business days). The stated purpose is complete delisting and privatization. The board decision to recommend acceptance was unanimous among independent directors (excluding those with conflicts of interest), and was conditioned on the offerors acquiring substantially all shares (excluding any non-tendering shares and treasury stock held by the company itself).
